property_summary: After NETM() sets owner's balance to totalDistributed (250000000e18), calling burn(250000000e18) succeeds in reference C but reverts in mutant M because M requires _value < balances[msg.sender] instead of <=.
change_summary: Replace `require(_value <= balances[msg.sender]);` with `require(_value < balances[msg.sender]);` so that burning the exact balance is disallowed.
